body.p: Tawkxwax found it very convenient to spend the winter underground as does the iguana. He asked the iguana to stay with him. The iguana agreed but only on the condition that Tawkxwax should not leave the den to relieve himself. Tawkxwax promised, but after a while he could restrain himself no longer and he went out and came back. He did this many times. The iguana noticed that Tawkxwax left many foot prints in the earth and as he was afraid some one might discover their hole he ordered Tawkxwax to leave. Tawkxwax left. Three months later he returned to look for the iguana, but he could not find the entrance to the den as it was closed by a caraguatá (Bromelia) plant.
